# MCP servers & CLI tools

MCP servers and command-line tools for building, debugging and researching: browser/devtools MCPs, code-graph and token savers, Blender/three.js MCPs, document converters for the case files, MCP SDKs, and everyday CLIs.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/tooling.md](../notes/tooling.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category tooling`
